Gyarados Changes (Japanese: ギャラドス、化わる Gyarados, Change) is the 578th chapter of the Pokémon Adventures manga, and the 30th chapter of the .

==Plot==
 

==Major events==
arrives in front of the Team Flare Secret HQ in Geosenge Town.
X is approached by Emma, who reveals she followed him and offers to help infiltrate the building.
Bryony sends Aliana and Mable away and knocks Celosia unconscious due to the effect of using her too much.
Bryony opens the HQ's doors for X and Emma.
X gets separated from Emma after stepping on a warp panel, sending him into the ultimate weapon's control room with Lysandre.
Lysandre reveals his Mega Ring with the Key Stone fitted from Korrina's Mega Glove and uses it to Mega Evolve his .
, , and finish their training with Gurkinn.
Gurkinn begins wondering if he should give Y his Key Stone.
informs everyone that X left.
Emma continues exploring the building, and ends up in front of the cell of a giant man.
